Definition: to be wise (in mind, word or act)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be wise; 1a) (Qal) to be or become wise, act wisely; 1b) (Piel) to make wise, teach wisdom, instruct; 1c) (Pual) to be made wise; 1d) (Hiphil) to make wise; 1e) (Hithpael) to show oneself wise, deceive, show one's wisdom
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
